methods.label: Wake, stun, and vents
methods.summary: Wake the Sire, stun it, and destroy the four respiratory systems before committing to the melee kill.
recommendedFor: players using a melee main setup with ranged or magic utility
requiredOrKeyItems: Shadow spell or ranged wake-up hit
prayers: Protect from Missiles while moving around the room
steps: Start by waking the Sire with a ranged or magic hit.
Use a shadow spell or other stun method so the respiratory systems can be attacked safely.
Destroy all four respiratory systems; Scorching bow can quickly remove vents where available.
Return to the centre and switch into melee gear for the main body.
risks: Standing still too long allows tentacles and poison pools to add avoidable damage.
Skipping vents makes the later kill slower and more dangerous.
notes: The respiratory systems are a separate utility phase from the melee DPS phase.

methods.label: Melee body and explosion phase
methods.summary: Use demonbane or strong melee weapons on the body, then move away from the final explosion and finish the Sire.
steps: Attack the Sire with the best available melee weapon after the respiratory systems are down.
Prioritise demonbane weapons when available because the Sire is demonic.
Move away from poison pools and spawned minions instead of tanking unnecessary damage.
When the Sire teleports and prepares the final explosion, run clear before returning to finish it.
risks: The final explosion can deal heavy damage if the player stays near the Sire.
Poison and minion pressure can drain supplies on slow kills.
